svg.title: Enclosure display — Fill, flavor 1 selected
svg.desc: Big Blue Fill screen. Flavor 1 is selected in the left rail and shown in the central portrait. Top navigation: Fill, Prime, Clean, Done. The task reads: Fill this flavor. Top it up. Pour concentrate into the top funnel. The orange button reads Start filling. The portraits are the factory Flavor 1 and Flavor 2 artwork.
